summary: The registrant filed a Form 8-K covering three items: (i) a board-approved salary increase for the CTO from $275k to $350k, a routine executive-compensation adjustment; (ii) announcement of acceptance into the AMD AI Developer Program via press release; and (iii) filing of Amendment No. 1 to a prospectus supplement for an additional $2,754,500 of common stock issuable under an existing sales agreement with Benchmark Company. None of these events constitute a special situation—no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or forced management departure. The salary increase is compensatory, not a departure, and the at-the-market offering amendment is a routine shelf takedown update.
